confidence_notes: Recent aggregated Lausanne price data supports the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors. The cocktail estimate follows a CHF 16 local downtown drink entry, about 1.9 times the local draft-beer price; the wine estimate uses a CHF 9 Lausanne restaurant-list median. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates based on the supplied Geneva, Zurich and Lugano comparables.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lausanne's year-typical accommodation costs are estimated near Zurich and Lugano, below Geneva's three-star price. Its university and lakeside tourism support prices above the lower end of the supplied Swiss comparables.
